members.note: representative; the concept of rectifying the mochin

concepts.gloss_en: The essence/main point of the rectification of the intellect — construct headed by עקר ('essence of'), a statement about what the tikkun principally consists of, not the tikkun itself

members.note: distinct construct head עקר ('the essence of X'); per rule 4 a phrase about X is not X

notes: Token overlap only. עקר תקון המחין adds the construct head עקר ('the essence of'), making it a claim about the tikkun (its main mechanism = breaking sexual desire) rather than a surface variant of תקון המחין. Kept separate per the under-merge and construct-head rules.
